fix.windows: Run Tenon on macOS or a supported Linux system.
fix.unsupported-platform: Use macOS or a supported Linux system.
fix.wsl1: Upgrade the distribution to WSL 2, then restart Tenon.
fix.root-without-setfcap: Run Tenon as a regular user, or ask an administrator to provide CAP_SETFCAP to this environment.
fix.missing-bwrap: Install bubblewrap in a terminal, for example sudo apt-get install bubblewrap, then restart Tenon.
fix.missing-socat: Install socat in a terminal, for example sudo apt-get install socat, then restart Tenon.
fix.missing-rg: Install ripgrep in a terminal, for example sudo apt-get install ripgrep, then restart Tenon.
fix.userns-restricted: Ask an administrator to check the sysctl readings and bwrap path below, configure /etc/apparmor.d/bwrap with an AppArmor profile granting userns only to bwrap itself, then reload AppArmor. Review these commands before running them in a terminal; Tenon does not run them. If the bwrap path is missing, install bubblewrap first. Changing sysctl alone is insufficient on some systems.
fix.nested-sandbox: Start Tenon directly from a system terminal outside the enclosing restricted environment.
fix.self-test-failed: Check the self-test details below, repair the system sandbox configuration, then restart Tenon.
fix.init-failed: Check the startup details below, repair dependencies, directory permissions or the environment, then restart Tenon.
fix.other: Check the original diagnostic below, repair the relevant system configuration, then restart Tenon.
fix.no-seccomp: Use a supported Linux architecture and a complete Tenon installation with a working apply-seccomp helper, then restart.
fix.old-bwrap: Upgrade bubblewrap to 0.5.0 or later, then restart Tenon.
fix.test-seam: Start Tenon outside tests with TENON_TEST_SANDBOX removed; this status does not indicate real protection.
